purpose: Reviewer 1 Concern 4: determine where evict_value_v1's per-decision computational overhead comes from, how much is avoidable research-prototype implementation cost vs fundamental algorithmic cost, whether selective/hybrid invocation or candidate pruning recovers most of the quality at a fraction of the cost, and at what synthetic miss-cost regime (if any) the added cost would be justified. Non-API only; see api_experiments_excluded below.
api_experiments_excluded: This protocol (v1) explicitly excludes any OpenAI/Gemini/Cohere/Azure/Cloudrift or other paid/external API call. An API-backed heterogeneous-inference-cost case study may be considered later, only as a v2, only if the non-API evidence here leaves a specific named gap, decided at the end of the v1 run -- never mid-run.

canonical_overhead_claim_source.measurement_scope: single trace (brightkite), 5000-request prefix, single run, timing boundary = whole policy.on_request() call, no component breakdown -- this v1 protocol extends coverage to all 7 certified traces x 3 capacities x repetitions, and adds a component-level breakdown.

traces.source: same 7 certified fair-comparison traces used throughout the reviewer-fairness protocol; hashes copied verbatim from analysis/reviewer_fairness/provenance_lrb.json

model_artifact.note: Same canonical artifact-backed scorer used throughout the manuscript's end-to-end evaluation; not retrained for this protocol.

timing_methodology.timer: time.perf_counter(), wrapped tightly around the timed unit only
timing_methodology.timing_boundary_whole_decision: each policy.on_request(request) call, matching scripts/run_overhead_benchmark.py's existing convention
timing_boundary_component: A_bookkeeping: hit/miss check, page-order bookkeeping (excludes candidate scoring)
B_candidate_construction: building the resident-candidate list for a full-cache miss
C_feature_extraction: compute_candidate_features_v1 (or its hoisted-invariant equivalent) across all candidates
F_other: residual (measured decision total minus A..E, includes Python/dict-allocation/framework overhead not separately isolated)
timing_methodology.warmup_treatment: first 200 timed decisions per (trace, capacity, variant, repetition) are discarded before computing statistics, to exclude interpreter/JIT/cache warm-up
timing_methodology.threading: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 (matches this repo's existing convention for controlled single-threaded runs, e.g. the cross-family training pipeline)
timing_methodology.cpu_affinity: not pinned -- this repository does not use taskset/CPU-affinity pinning anywhere else either; documented as a limitation, not silently omitted
timing_methodology.controlled_run_requirement: final reviewer-facing timing numbers must be collected while no other Concern-1/2/3 job (evict_cross_family_resume, objective_ablation_pipeline, distribution_shift_2h_continue, or the legacy LRB baseline process) is actively consuming CPU; see docs/practical_significance_ablation_protocol.md Section 'Hardware-controlled timing gate'.

profiling_request_budget.note: matches scripts/run_overhead_benchmark.py's existing single-trace convention; extended here to all 7 traces

cached_exact.description: Hoists compute_predictor_scores/compute_lru_scores/pred_victim/lru_victim/cache-level aggregate stats (bucket mean/std/min/max, confidence mean/std, unique-bucket-count) and the recent-request/hit-rate Counters out of the per-candidate loop -- computed once per eviction decision instead of once per candidate. Still calls predict_loss_one per candidate.

vectorized_exact.description: Keeps canonical per-candidate feature construction, but batches all k candidate feature rows into one EvictValueV1Model.predict_loss_batch call instead of k separate predict_loss_one calls.

vectorized_cached_exact.description: Combines cached_exact's hoisting with vectorized_exact's batched prediction.

exact_equivalence_requirement: Every optimization_variants entry marked exact:true must produce an identical hit/miss sequence AND an identical eviction (victim) sequence to canonical, on the same trace, same model artifact, same capacity, same seed. Verified by tests/test_practical_significance_ablation.py. Any variant that changes even one decision must be reclassified as a quality/cost tradeoff variant (selective_invocation_variants or topk_variants below), never left under optimization_variants.

disagreement_lru_sieve.description: Invoke the learned scorer only when the cheap LRU victim and a cheap shadow-SIEVE victim (visited-bit/hand state tracked over the real resident candidate set, updated on every request regardless of invocation) disagree; otherwise evict the LRU victim.

periodic.description: Invoke the learned scorer on 1 of every K evictions; otherwise evict the LRU victim.

deferred.candidate_ambiguity: Deferred: requires specifying a predeclared cheap ambiguity signal beyond this protocol's scope; not implemented in v1.
deferred.score_margin_confidence: Excluded per the task brief's explicit anti-circularity warning: obtaining a score margin already requires paying the full learned-inference cost, which would make the 'selective' label circular.

topk_pruning.cheap_prefilter: LRU recency order (already maintained by evict_value_v1's internal _order) selects the k most LRU-eligible (oldest) candidates; the learned scorer evaluates only those k.
topk_pruning.k_grid_note: For each capacity, only k values strictly less than that capacity are meaningful pruning and are used; k >= capacity degenerates to canonical (no pruning) and is skipped.

model_complexity_variants.source: Reuses the already-frozen h4 training grid artifacts (models/evict_value_wulver_v1_h4_{ridge,random_forest,hist_gb}.pkl in the main repository worktree) -- same target, same features, same training data. No new model search.
model_complexity_variants.purpose: Determine how much of the practical cost comes from model choice vs the supervision framework itself.

break_even_analysis.cost_model: TotalCost_p(Cmiss) = DecisionComputeCost_p + Misses_p * Cmiss, where DecisionComputeCost_p is applied only on evictions (full-cache misses), not on every request.
break_even_analysis.break_even_formula: Cmiss* = (ComputeCost_learned - ComputeCost_b) / (Misses_b - Misses_learned), defined only when Misses_b > Misses_learned
break_even_analysis.no_crossover_rule: If Misses_learned >= Misses_b for baseline b, report explicitly: 'no positive miss penalty makes the current learned policy preferable to b under this simple additive cost model' -- do not compute or report a spurious/negative break-even number.

baselines.fourth_baseline_selection_rule: argmin(mean total misses across the certified reviewer_fairness primary fair-window rows) among the original implementable non-oracle, non-evict_value_v1 baselines -- determined programmatically at run time by the runner, never hand-picked.

miss_cost_sweep.disclaimer: This grid is a synthetic sensitivity sweep. It is not a claim that any of these values correspond to a real storage/serving system's actual miss cost.

weighted_cost_analysis.real_metadata_audit_result: AUDITED: the canonical trace loader (lafc.simulator.request_trace.build_requests_from_lists, invoked via lafc.evict_value_wulver_v1.load_trace_from_any -> _parse_jsonl_trace) assigns Page.weight = 1.0 uniformly for every page when no explicit weights dict is supplied, which is always the case for the 7 certified .jsonl traces. No real heterogeneous per-object cost/size/latency metadata exists in the pipeline actually used for evaluation.

synthetic_scheme.name: lognormal_per_page_cost_multiplier
synthetic_scheme.distribution: cost_multiplier(page_id) = exp(Normal(mu=0, sigma=1)), one deterministic draw per unique page_id
synthetic_scheme.seed_derivation: numpy.random.default_rng(0), draws consumed in the sorted order of unique page_id strings within each trace, for full reproducibility independent of dict/set iteration order
synthetic_scheme.applied_as: weighted_miss_cost = sum over scored misses of (base_Cmiss * cost_multiplier(page_id)), evaluated at each grid point in miss_cost_sweep

weighted_cost_analysis.disclaimer: Synthetic costs are not claimed to be real-world measurements of any kind. This is a sensitivity analysis only, testing whether heterogeneous miss consequences change which policy is preferable, holding the same underlying hit/miss decisions fixed.

pareto_analysis.note: Dominated learned-policy variants must be reported, not hidden.

not_modified_after_seeing_performance: Any change to this protocol after final performance numbers are seen requires creating configs/practical_significance_ablation_v2.json; this file (v1) must not be edited in place once measurement begins.
